about: The agent list at the top left folds to a chip and opens again (2026-11-22: an expandable window that, folded, shows only the number of active agents). Its window's top edge sits on the top-right button row's top (2026-11-22: top-aligned with that row; --topbar-y, TOPBAR.Y in live.html), open or folded. On first run it is open (today's list) under one top line, 'N active' and a chevron; that line is a button (tree-toggle). A click folds the window to that line alone, in the same corner, meeting nothing; while an agent asks you, the chip carries the asking sign in orange. The choice survives a reload. Enter and Space on the focused button toggle it; Esc does what it did before (the list stays as it is). Opened again, a click on an agent's row opens that agent. Works on any floor with at least one agent; the waiting check runs only where an agent asks (live.html?stress=6&tick=1 has one).
